content.text: /ext:medcp Select a standard therapy for phenylketonuria and report how many patients here received it.
I'll first check the knowledge graph for a standard PKU therapy, then count patients in the clinical records who received it.

arguments.cypher_query: MATCH (d)-[r]-(x) WHERE toLower(coalesce(d.name,'')) CONTAINS 'phenylketonuria' RETURN labels(d) AS labels, d.name AS name, type(r) AS rel, labels(x) AS xlabels, x.name AS xname LIMIT 50

Sapropterin (BH4, brand Kuvan) is the standard first-line pharmacologic therapy for PKU. Let me count patients who received it in the clinical records.
This is an OMOP CDM database. I'll find the Sapropterin drug concepts and count distinct patients with a matching drug exposure.

arguments.sql_query:
SELECT concept_id, concept_name, domain_id, vocabulary_id, concept_class_id, standard_concept
FROM omop.concept
WHERE domain_id = 'Drug' AND LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%sapropterin%'
ORDER BY standard_concept, concept_name;

arguments.sql_query:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT de.person_id) AS n_patients
FROM omop.drug_exposure de
WHERE de.drug_concept_id IN (
  SELECT ca.descendant_concept_id
  FROM omop.concept_ancestor ca
  WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id = 19021959
);
